_comment: T-295: per-class primary-attribute growth. `base` = the level-1 value of every primary; `per_level` = the gain added per level-up, keyed by class archetype. This is the canonical source for leveling.gd (which mirrors it in-code as a deterministic fallback if this file is missing). Class identity: warrior = STR/STA (melee + HP), mage = INT (spell power/mana), priest = INT/Spirit (healing + mana regen). Adding a class is a new row here. Evolution of T-061's in-code table.
